entities.name: RAG
entities.description: A system where a user query retrieves relevant information from external data sources to incorporate into the generation of a response by an LLM.

entities.name: Ram et al., 2023
entities.description: A cited reference describing the process of populating a prompt template with a query and retrieved records.

entities.name: vector RAG
entities.description: A family of conventional RAG approaches that use text embeddings to retrieve records closest to the query in vector space.

entities.name: Gao et al., 2023
entities.description: A cited reference associated with the use of text embeddings for semantic similarity retrieval.

entities.name: GraphRAG
entities.description: A method that contrasts with vector RAG by answering queries requiring global sensemaking over the entire data corpus.

relationships.description: The description of RAG cites Ram et al., 2023.
The description of vector RAG using text embeddings cites Gao et al., 2023.
GraphRAG contrasts with vector RAG in its ability to answer queries requiring global sensemaking.
